question:
Select the most appropriate synonym of the underlined word in the given sentence.

Any declarations or practices of religious __antipathy__ against ethnic minorities in a democratic country should not be tolerated.
solution:
The correct answer is: **Option 3**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word **"antipathy"** means a deep-seated feeling of dislike; aversion. (घृणा)

 
 
• **Example: **His **antipathy **towards the new policy was evident in his speech.
 
 
 
• **"Enmity"** refers to a state of active opposition or hostility. (शत्रुता)
 
 
• **Example: **There has been a long history of **enmity **between the two neighbouring countries.
 
 
 
• Hence, we can infer that the synonym of **'antipathy'** is **'enmity'**.

Therefore, the correct answer is: **Option 3**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

 
• **Passivity** (निष्क्रियता): Acceptance of what happens, without active response or resistance.

 
 
• **Example:** His **passivity **in the face of injustice was quite surprising.
 
 
 
• **Devaluation** (मूल्यह्रास): Reduction or underestimation of the worth or importance of something.
 
 
• **Example: **The **devaluation **of the currency caused economic instability.
 
 
 
• **Conformity** (अनुरूपता): Compliance with standards, rules, or laws.
 
 
• **Example:** The company's **conformity **to industry regulations ensured its credibility.
